data.name: Mahadu
data.gender_notes: Mahadu is used as a masculine name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mahadu is a Sanskrit and Hindi name meaning 'great', 'majestic'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'maha' meaning 'great' and 'du' meaning 'two'. This name is often given to boys who are expected to lead and inspire others with their strength and courage. The name Mahadu carries the meaning “Majestic, Great” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Mahadu usually hope their child will grow to embody majestic, great and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mahadu is a powerful and spiritual name, rooted in the ancient traditions of Hinduism. It represents the inner strength and courage that is needed to overcome life's challenges and live a meaningful and fulfilling life.
data.etymology: Mahadu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Majestic, Great.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahadu total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
